title: feat(roadmap): record the reference hits of a stage case in the replay
summary: The plan moves the claim module to a new path and leaves the two test modules that hold its old dotted name unchanged. The reference check of the job refuses the plan, because a moved module needs a group that changes every file that holds its old name.
notes: The plan is a move plan of the replay case: one group renames a module and no group changes the two test modules that hold the old dotted name.
The change was never merged as this plan, so `pull`, `merge_commit` and `base_commit` hold the issue number and two placeholders: the case reads no commit, and the facts hold the files of its tree.

defects.problem: The group renames `src/devops_cli/roadmap/claim.py` to `src/devops_cli/roadmap/ownership.py` and no group changes `tests/roadmap/test_roadmap_claim.py` or `tests/roadmap/test_roadmap_claim_command.py`. The two test modules import the old dotted name, so the move leaves them broken.
defects.evidence: `tests/roadmap/test_roadmap_claim.py` line 17 reads `from devops_cli.roadmap.claim import`, and `tests/roadmap/test_roadmap_claim_command.py` line 11 reads `from devops_cli.roadmap.claim import dry_run_claim`. Neither path is in the group `changes` or in its `creates`.
